prompt:
Which operating power plants in Harris County, Texas with an operating capacity of at least 100 MW are within 500 meters of FEMA's Special Flood Hazard Area (including any inside it)? Give their names.

Your working directory: /root/.cache/hifld-qgis-agent-errors/workspace/claude-haiku-5.5/Q6_3

datasets_used: HIFLD Next power-plants-1 (geopackage, downloaded to power_plants.gpkg)
output.method: Filtered HIFLD power plants to COUNTYFIPS 48201 (Harris), STATUS = OP, and OPER_CAP >= 100 MW, giving 18 plants. Dissolved the SFHA polygons (SFHA_TF = 'T') in EPSG:32615 (UTM 15N, metric), buffered them by 500 m, and kept plants that intersect that buffer, which includes plants inside the SFHA. Five plants qualified; the other 13 were beyond 500 m.
